articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); Libanon: "Es herrschte totale Panik"
articles.teaser: Khayrieh Zayoun floh aus dem Süden des Libanon. Dort rückt Israels Armee gerade immer weiter vor. Nun ist sie eine von vielen Vertriebenen, die sich fragen: Wohin?
articles.image_title: Libanon: Lebanon, Beirut, 2026. Khayneb Zayoun 73 ,and her husband Yousef Kassem 85, fled from Chehour village in southern Lebanon where Israeli attacks began on March 2nd and took shelter in a stadium in Beirut. They were awake at 2am for sohour then Israeli airstrikes began. ‘Everybody started leaving their homes in panic. It was continues airstrike’. It took 7 hours for them until Beirut - on a pickup of their son. They first arrived at Sheyfet, green area at outskirts of Beirut and slept under the trees as Dahiyeh, southern suburb of Beirut was under the heavy air strikes too. They felt safe to stay in the park for the night and spent the next day at their relatives who live near Dahiyeh. Then they had to move again when Israelis ordered the evacuation of southern suburb, which is home to more than 700k people and arrived in this stadium. This is the third time they are displaced; first was on 2006, then in 2024 and March 2026. According to the Ministry of Social Affairs, over 1 million people are now internally displaced within Lebanon as of March 17, since Israeli attacks on Lebanon began on March 2, 2026.

articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); Polit-Influencer: "Ich sehe aus, wie die Nazis sich das wünschen: Groß, blond, stark"
articles.teaser: Marcant ist in einem Jahr vom Jura-Studenten zum einflussreichen Polit-Influencer geworden. Er sucht Gespräche mit Nazis und AfDlern. Und lebt mit dem, was daraus folgt.
articles.image_title: Polit-Influencer: Aufgewachsen ist Marc, 23, in Hessen, in einem kleinen Ort bei Frankfurt. Seine Schulzeit dort war eine Lektion im Starksein, sagt er.
